topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The doorbell rang, and there they were—vibrant roses, wrapped in a simple, elegant paper. No card, no note, just a bouquet carrying an enigmatic message through silence. Each petal whispered secrets only the giver knew. I stepped back into my living room, the flowers in hand, their scent subtly filling the air, a breath of someone's thoughtful presence. I placed them in a vase by the window, sunlight dancing on the dewy petals. The day had brightened, not just with the sun, but with a mystery that wrapped itself around the ordinary, turning it into something luminous. I found myself smiling, contemplating the faces of those who might have sent such a beautiful, wordless gift.
